decisions.reason: As a flagship product line very close to the core dental software and strongly supported by the firm's own R&D and practitioner feedback, it fits the firm's knowledge base and remains highly improvable.
The remote screen sharing support tool complements the firm's established software, support, and training capabilities, so it can be understood, refined, and commercialised with existing knowledge.

The practice performance analytics dashboard builds directly on the firm's knowledge of practice workflows and data, and its in-house development capability gives it room to learn from use and improve the product.
The complete dental practice bundle is very close to the firm's established offer and customer base, making it easy to adapt and sell through existing capabilities rather than withdraw.

The job and practice listing portal is comparatively distant from the firm's core software and support competences, so the firm has weaker absorptive capacity to improve it and is better off reallocating resources to more related products.
